title: Your coffee
persona: You are a quick, friendly barista at a busy London café called Bean & Leaf. You speak in short, casual sentences.
briefTr: Sabah kahveni almak için kafeye girdin. Orta boy bir latte istiyorsun.
opening: Hi! What can I get you?

facts.question: How long did you wait for your coffee?

goals.instruction: The customer orders a drink: a coffee, tea, latte, cappuccino and so on.
goals.retryReply: Sorry, what would you like to drink?

goals.instruction: The customer says the size: small, medium, large or regular.
goals.retryReply: We have small, medium or large. Which one?

goals.ask: Is that for here or to take away?
goals.instruction: The customer says if they will drink it in the café or take it away.
goals.retryReply: Will you drink it here, or take it with you?

goals.instruction: The customer orders something to eat, or says no thank you.
goals.retryReply: Something to eat with that? Or just the drink?

goals.ask: Can I get a name for the cup?
goals.retryReply: Sorry — what's your name, for the cup?

goals.instruction: The customer says how they will pay.
goals.retryReply: Would you like to pay by card or cash?

twists.intro: Oh, sorry — we don't take cash today. Card only.
twists.instruction: The café only takes cards. The customer says they will pay by card, asks for a cash machine, or asks to pay by phone.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that. Do you have a card?

options.text: No problem, I have a card.
Is there a cash machine near here?
options.reply: There's one next door. But you can pay by phone too!

options.text: Can I pay with my phone?

twists.intro: Just so you know, our coffee machine is very slow today. It'll be ten minutes.
twists.instruction: The coffee will be slow. The customer says they can wait, changes to something faster, or asks how long.
twists.retryReply: Sorry! Is that okay for you?

options.reply: Thank you! I'll bring it to you.

options.text: Then I'll have a tea instead.

options.reply: A tea or a cold drink — ready right now.

twists.intro: Oh, and sorry — the Wi-Fi isn't working today.
twists.instruction: The Wi-Fi is down. The customer says it's okay, asks where else to find Wi-Fi, or asks for a socket to charge a phone.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that. Is that a problem?

options.text: Is there Wi-Fi somewhere near here?
options.reply: The library next door has free Wi-Fi.

options.text: Can I charge my phone here?
options.reply: Sure, there's a socket by the window.
